challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Two Alex-initiated one-on-one plans provide meaningful support for special interest, although the museum visit concerned an interest shared by the group.
Remembering the presentation, texting encouragement, and bringing drink options show personal attentiveness, but MB-F4 indicates that Alex also checks on and brings treats for others.
The extended conversations and personal updates support a closer connection, but their mixed group and personal content does not clearly establish romantic interest.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: B remains the better-supported primary interpretation after giving MB-F1 through MB-F3 full weight. Those facts create a real possibility of special interest, but MB-F4 shows comparable friendliness toward others, MB-F5 records no explicit romantic signal over ten weeks, and MB-F6 shows two postponements without a replacement date. The repeated facts therefore qualify but do not outweigh the evidence for general friendliness.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: Maintain the current level of engagement without assuming romantic interest; the evidence supports friendliness more strongly while leaving some uncertainty.
